memory_note: D shows the actor the 3 stored trajectories most similar to goal + current subgoal; here ranked with the same embedder by goal only (the recorded run does not store the exact per-subgoal selection), so treat the list as the typical retrieval, not a log.
shows: Goal "put a statue in coffeetable" with an earlier statue game in memory. The agent still searches 10 steps (the statue is on the tvstand), so the memory did not tell it where the object is, only how the task is done.
why_interesting: Trajectory memory transfers the procedure, not the layout: the earlier solution came from another room.
